desc: 暖橙齿边纸面加长毛绒台面，拆解童贴身两件套，卖点与规格全走空白卡位
leaf: 儿童贴身棉毛内衣两件套
name: 暖橙云边童贴身两件套款

shots.intent: 在搜索列表里一秒给出成套贴身装的量感与暖调气质，用叠装加毛绒台面替代通用白底棚拍，抢首图点击。
shots.textZone: top marigold band carries one short headline line; a lower rail holds three empty rounded chip slots

shots.intent: 把原页的环形优势清单改造成一眼读完的核心主张板，用空徽章加空白云形卡承接最多三条卖点。
shots.textZone: three of six petal cells carry one short label each, the remaining cells stay blank

shots.intent: 用同框同光的布料状态对照放大单层薄内衣不蓬不暖的日常困扰，把痛点交给画面而非数字。
复刻原页的剖面窗口逻辑，用三枚并置圆窗讲清厚度层次结构，材质与层数全部留白由真实参数填写。
让家长代入真实居家穿着时刻，儿童一律颈部以下裁切加背影，只做身形与松量不给面孔。
用完整平铺交代上下两件的版型与袖长裤长比例，消除尺码与套件内容的想象差。
用织口与缝份的真实微距替代口头工艺宣称，让人自己看到包边与罗纹的做法。
把原页的颜色分类屏做成两格同折法同光对照，让买家在两个色系之间自选而不下架疑虑。
shots.textZone: one blank colour-name plate under each cell, wording supplied later

shots.intent: 承接原页的指数滑条、尺码宽表与洗护符号三块信息屏，全部做成空白位，由真实参数后期填入以降风险。
shots.textZone: one blank header rail plus empty plates, grid cells and icon frames, all wording supplied later

shots.intent: 用整套叠装加空白按钮位收口，把行动引导留在同一暖橙版式里而不依赖促销数字。
shots.textZone: one short closing line above a blank rounded button block along the lower rail

style.backgroundSystem: two-field poster stage only: a marigold scallop-edged band #DD8C3F running across the top of the opening screen over a cream paper field #FAEDD6, alternating with a deep marigold #DD8C3F page base carrying cream cards #FCF4E6, plus two screens on a dusty-blue paper field #A8C4DE; no pure white seamless studio sweep anywhere in the set
style.direction: warm scallop-paper poster commerce for kids innerwear
style.iconSystem: die-cut scallop-edged masks with a dashed stitch outline, one empty circular badge with no digit, blank petal label cells, hollow thin-line care-icon frames, empty attribute rails with one hollow round marker; every icon and plate stays unprinted
style.lightingSystem: warm 4500K soft studio light, broad key from the upper left with a large wraparound fill, a skimming sweep from the right on texture screens to open the knit relief, feathered contact shadows only, never a hard specular dot
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent warm scallop-paper kids innerwear visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of a marigold poster block #DD8C3F, a cream paper field #FAEDD6, a pale cream card stock #FCF4E6 and deep-roast ink #4B3524, with one dusty-blue insert field #A8C4DE on two screens only; warm 4500K soft studio light with an upper-left key, wraparound fill, a skimming sweep on texture screens and feathered contact shadows; ivory shearling pile #F4EDE3 and kraft-edge mat #E7CDA6 as resting surfaces; one rounded geometric sans-serif family in deep-roast ink; die-cut scallop-edged masks with a dashed stitch outline, an empty circular badge and hollow thin-line icon frames, every plate left unprinted; matched two-piece set at stable fold and scale; no color palette changes, no fifth accent hue, no mixed fonts, no pure white seamless sweep, no outdoor scenery, no inconsistent lighting, no filled-in digits or units, no third-party character artwork.
noDrift: no color palette changes and no fifth accent hue outside the four locked tones
no mixed fonts, no serif, no brush lettering and no handwritten display type
no pure white seamless studio background and no outdoor or garden scenery
no inconsistent lighting and no hard specular highlight on the knit
no filled-in digits, units, layer counts, composition names or measurement values in any slot
no third-party character artwork, badge marks, shelf-ready logo plates or copyright rows
style.presentationRules: the long-sleeve top and the trousers always appear as one matched two-piece set; identical fold, scale and slight overhead-to-dead-front placement across screens; print scale and ribbed cuff depth taken from the reference garment and never redrawn
style.surfaceSystem: ivory shearling pile surface #F4EDE3 for the stacked packshot and the lifestyle floor, kraft-edge mat #E7CDA6 under flat lays, cream card stock #FCF4E6 as the information board
style.typography: one rounded geometric sans-serif family, deep-roast ink #4B3524 for headline and label slots, short callout lines only, no dense body copy, no serif, no brush lettering, no handwriting
